caption: Distribution of Quantifiers and Operations in Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, Disjunctive Reasoning, and Conjunctive Reasoning.
model_annotation: The figure presents three pie charts showing the distribution of quantifiers and logical operations across task types: “Categorical,” “Approximate Number Generation,” and “Disjunctive & Conjunctive.” The Categorical chart contains 5 slices with percentage labels inside: Universal Quantifiers (light blue) at 29.07%, Limiter (pink) at 27.91%, Negation (orange) at 27.91%, Existential Quantifiers (light green) at 15.12%, and a very thin, unlabeled pale slice near the top (approximately ~0–1%). The Approximate Number Generation chart contains 4 slices with internal labels: Approximate Quantities (pale yellow) at 45.03%, Comparative Relationships (light blue) at 36.26%, Absolute Absence (lavender/purple) at 18.71%, and a very thin, unlabeled pale slice near the top (approximately ~0–1%). The Disjunctive & Conjunctive chart contains 2 slices split nearly in half, labeled inside: Disjunctive (light blue) at 49.51% and Conjunctive (pink) at 50.49%. No separate legend is shown, percentages are printed within slices, no slices appear exploded or offset, and the slice ordering does not appear strictly sorted by size.
